+    def _print_Derivative(self, expr):
+        dexpr = expr.expr
+        dvars = list(expr.variables)
+        grouped = []
+        i = 0
+        while i < len(dvars):
+            v = dvars[i]
+            count = 1
+            while i + count < len(dvars) and dvars[i + count] == v:
+                count += 1
+            grouped.append(v if count == 1 else (v, count))
+            i += count
+        return "Hold[D[" + ', '.join(self.doprint(a) for a in [dexpr] + grouped) + "]]"
+
+    def _print_Float(self, expr):
+        res = str(expr)
+        return res.replace('e', '*^')
